versos.grego: Ὀφείλομεν δὲ ἡμεῖς οἱ δυνατοὶ τὰ ἀσθενήματα τῶν ἀδυνάτων βαστάζειν, καὶ μὴ ἑαυτοῖς ἀρέσκειν.

controles.web: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
controles.kjv: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
controles.livre: Mas nós, que somos fortes, devemos suportar as fraquezas dos fracos, e não agradar a nós mesmos.

versos.grego: ἕκαστος ἡμῶν τῷ πλησίον ἀρεσκέτω εἰς τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς οἰκοδομήν·

controles.web: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
controles.kjv: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
controles.livre: Portanto, cada um de nós agrade ao próximo no que é bom para a edificação.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐχ ἑαυτῷ ἤρεσεν· ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται Οἱ ὀνειδισμοὶ τῶν ὀνειδιζόντων σε ἐπέπεσαν ἐπ’ ἐμέ.

controles.web: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
controles.kjv: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
controles.livre: Pois também Cristo não agradou a si mesmo; mas, como está escrito: “Os insultos dos que te insultavam caíram sobre mim”.

versos.grego: ὅσα γὰρ προεγράφη, εἰς τὴν ἡμετέραν διδασκαλίαν ἐγράφη, ἵνα διὰ τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ διὰ τῆς παρακλήσεως τῶν γραφῶν τὴν ἐλπίδα ἔχωμεν.

controles.web: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through patience and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
controles.kjv: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
controles.livre: Pois todas as coisas que foram escritas com antecedência foram escritas para o nosso ensino; para que, pela paciência e consolação das Escrituras, tenhamos esperança.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Θεὸς τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ τῆς παρακλήσεως δῴη ὑμῖν τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖν ἐν ἀλλήλοις κατὰ Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν,

controles.web: Now the God of patience and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus,
controles.kjv: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
controles.livre: O Deus da paciência e da consolação vos dê a mesma mentalidade uns para com os outros, segundo Cristo Jesus,

versos.grego: ἵνα ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐν ἑνὶ στόματι δοξάζητε τὸν Θεὸν καὶ Πατέρα τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: a fim de que, em comum acordo, como uma só boca, glorifiqueis ao Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Διὸ προσλαμβάνεσθε ἀλλήλους, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς προσελάβετο ἡμᾶς, εἰς δόξαν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
controles.kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
controles.livre: Portanto, recebei uns aos outros, assim como também Cristo nos recebeu para a glória de Deus.

versos.grego: λέγω γὰρ Χριστὸν διάκονον γεγενῆσθαι περιτομῆς ὑπὲρ ἀληθείας Θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ βεβαιῶσαι τὰς ἐπαγγελίας τῶν πατέρων,

controles.web: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,
controles.kjv: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
controles.livre: Pois digo que Cristo se tornou servidor da circuncisão por causa da verdade de Deus, para confirmar as promessas feitas aos patriarcas;

versos.grego: τὰ δὲ ἔθνη ὑπὲρ ἐλέους δοξάσαι τὸν Θεόν, καθὼς γέγραπται Διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν ἔθνεσιν καὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου ψαλῶ.

controles.web: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written,  “Therefore will I give praise to you among the Gentiles, and sing to your name.”
controles.kjv: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
controles.livre: e para que os gentios glorifiquem a Deus por causa de sua misericórdia, como está escrito: “Por isso entre os gentios te confessarei, e ao teu nome cantarei.”

versos.grego: καὶ πάλιν λέγει Εὐφράνθητε, ἔθνη, μετὰ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Again he says,  “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”
controles.kjv: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
controles.livre: E outra vez diz: “Alegrai-vos, gentios, com o povo dele.”

versos.grego: καὶ πάλιν Αἰνεῖτε, πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, τὸν Κύριον, καὶ ἐπαινεσάτωσαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ λαοί.

controles.web: Again,  “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”
controles.kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
controles.livre: E outra vez: “Louvai ao Senhor todas as nações, e celebrai-o todos os povos.”

versos.grego: καὶ πάλιν Ἡσαΐας λέγει Ἔσται ἡ ῥίζα τοῦ Ἰεσσαί, καὶ ὁ ἀνιστάμενος ἄρχειν ἐθνῶν· ἐπ’ αὐτῷ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν.

controles.web: Again, Isaiah says,  “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”
controles.kjv: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
controles.livre: E outra vez Isaías diz: “Haverá a raiz de Jessé, e aquele que se levantará para governar as nações; nele os gentios esperarão.”

versos.grego: Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς τῆς ἐλπίδος πληρώσαι ὑμᾶς πάσης χαρᾶς καὶ εἰρήνης ἐν τῷ πιστεύειν, εἰς τὸ περισσεύειν ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἐλπίδι ἐν δυνάμει Πνεύματος Ἁγίου.

controles.web: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
controles.kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
controles.livre: O Deus da esperança vos encha de toda alegria e paz na fé, para que abundeis em esperança no poder do Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: Πέπεισμαι δέ, ἀδελφοί μου, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐγὼ περὶ ὑμῶν, ὅτι καὶ αὐτοὶ μεστοί ἐστε ἀγαθωσύνης, πεπληρωμένοι πάσης τῆς γνώσεως, δυνάμενοι καὶ ἀλλήλους νουθετεῖν.

controles.web: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.
controles.kjv: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
controles.livre: Porém, meus irmãos, convencido estou acerca de vós de que também estais cheios de bondade, plenos de todo conhecimento, e capazes de também aconselhardes  uns aos outros.

versos.grego: τολμηροτέρως δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἀπὸ μέρους, ὡς ἐπαναμιμνήσκων ὑμᾶς, διὰ τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ

controles.web: But I write the more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,
controles.kjv: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
controles.livre: Mas em parte vos escrevi com mais ousadia, como que para vos relembrar, por causa da graça que me foi dada por Deus,

versos.grego: εἰς τὸ εἶναί με λειτουργὸν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ εἰς τὰ ἔθνη, ἱερουργοῦντα τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἵνα γένηται ἡ προσφορὰ τῶν ἐθνῶν εὐπρόσδεκτος, ἡγιασμένη ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ.

controles.web: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
controles.kjv: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
controles.livre: a fim de que eu seja um servidor de Cristo Jesus entre os gentios, ministrando o evangelho de Deus, para que a oferta dos gentios seja agradável, santificada pelo Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: ἔχω οὖν τὴν καύχησιν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τὰ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν·

controles.web: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
controles.kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
controles.livre: Assim eu me orgulho em Jesus Cristo das coisas relacionadas a Deus,

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ τολμήσω τι λαλεῖν ὧν οὐ κατειργάσατο Χριστὸς δι’ ἐμοῦ εἰς ὑπακοὴν ἐθνῶν, λόγῳ καὶ ἔργῳ,

controles.web: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
controles.kjv: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
controles.livre: Pois eu não ousaria falar coisa alguma, a não ser o que Cristo fez por meio de mim, para tornar os gentios obedientes,  por meio da palavra e da obra,

versos.grego: ἐν δυνάμει σημείων καὶ τεράτων, ἐν δυνάμει Πνεύματος Ἁγίου· ὥστε με ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ κύκλῳ μέχρι τοῦ Ἰλλυρικοῦ πεπληρωκέναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;
controles.kjv: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
controles.livre: com poder de sinais e milagres, no poder do EspíritoSanto; de maneira que desde Jerusalém e redondezas até Ilírico, cumpri a pregação do Evangelho de Cristo.

versos.grego: οὕτως δὲ φιλοτιμούμενον εὐαγγελίζεσθαι οὐχ ὅπου ὠνομάσθη Χριστός, ἵνα μὴ ἐπ’ ἀλλότριον θεμέλιον οἰκοδομῶ,

controles.web: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
controles.kjv: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:
controles.livre: E assim quis muito anunciar o Evangelho onde Cristo não houvesse sido pregado, para que eu não construísse sobre fundamento alheio;

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται Ὄψονται οἷς οὐκ ἀνηγγέλη περὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ οἳ οὐκ ἀκηκόασιν συνήσουσιν.

controles.web: But, as it is written,  “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
controles.kjv: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
controles.livre: ao contrário, como está escrito: “Aqueles a quem dele não foi anunciado o verão; e os que não ouviram entenderão.”

versos.grego: Διὸ καὶ ἐνεκοπτόμην τὰ πολλὰ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς·

controles.web: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
controles.kjv: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
controles.livre: Por isso também muitas vezes tenho sido impedido de ir até vós.

versos.grego: νυνὶ δὲ μηκέτι τόπον ἔχων ἐν τοῖς κλίμασι τούτοις, ἐπιποθίαν δὲ ἔχων τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ ἱκανῶν ἐτῶν,

controles.web: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
controles.kjv: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
controles.livre: Mas agora, como nessas regiões não há mais lugar em que eu precise trabalhar,  e já por muitos anos tive grande desejo de ir até vós,

versos.grego: ὡς ἂν πορεύωμαι εἰς τὴν Σπανίαν· ἐλπίζω γὰρ διαπορευόμενος θεάσασθαι ὑμᾶς καὶ ὑφ’ ὑμῶν προπεμφθῆναι ἐκεῖ, ἐὰν ὑμῶν πρῶτον ἀπὸ μέρους ἐμπλησθῶ.

controles.web: whenever I journey to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
controles.kjv: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
controles.livre: quando eu for para a Espanha pois espero vos ver no caminho, e receber ajuda de vossa parte para a viagem, depois de primeiramente ficar um tempo satisfazendo o desejo de estar convosco.

versos.grego: —νυνὶ δὲ πορεύομαι εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ διακονῶν τοῖς ἁγίοις.

controles.web: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
controles.kjv: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
controles.livre: Mas por ora, vou a Jerusalém, a fim de auxiliar os santos.

versos.grego: ηὐδόκησαν γὰρ Μακεδονία καὶ Ἀχαΐα κοινωνίαν τινὰ ποιήσασθαι εἰς τοὺς πτωχοὺς τῶν ἁγίων τῶν ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ.

controles.web: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Pois, aos da Macedônia e Acaia pareceu bem fazer uma contribuição para os pobres dentre os santos que estão em Jerusalém.

versos.grego: ηὐδόκησαν γάρ, καὶ ὀφειλέται εἰσὶν αὐτῶν· εἰ γὰρ τοῖς πνευματικοῖς αὐτῶν ἐκοινώνησαν τὰ ἔθνη, ὀφείλουσιν καὶ ἐν τοῖς σαρκικοῖς λειτουργῆσαι αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in fleshly things.
controles.kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
controles.livre: Isso lhes pareceu bem, como quem está em dívida para com eles; porque, se os gentios foram participantes dos seus bens espirituais, devem também ajudá-los com os materiais.

versos.grego: τοῦτο οὖν ἐπιτελέσας, καὶ σφραγισάμενος αὐτοῖς τὸν καρπὸν τοῦτον, ἀπελεύσομαι δι’ ὑμῶν εἰς Σπανίαν·

controles.web: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
controles.kjv: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
controles.livre: Assim que eu concluir isso, e garantir a entrega desse fruto a eles, partirei para a Espanha passando para vos visitar.

versos.grego: οἶδα δὲ ὅτι ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν πληρώματι εὐλογίας Χριστοῦ ἐλεύσομαι.

controles.web: I know that, when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
controles.kjv: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
controles.livre: E sei que, quando chegar até vós, virei com a plenitude da bênção  de Cristo.

versos.grego: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ Πνεύματος συναγωνίσασθαί μοι ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν,

controles.web: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
controles.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ’s sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
controles.livre: Rogo-vos, porém, irmãos, pelo nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, e pelo amor do Espírito, que luteis comigo em orações a Deus por mim,

versos.grego: ἵνα ῥυσθῶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀπειθούντων ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ ἡ διακονία μου ἡ εἰς Ἱερουσαλὴμ εὐπρόσδεκτος τοῖς ἁγίοις γένηται,

controles.web: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;
controles.kjv: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
controles.livre: para que eu esteja livre dos rebeldes na Judeia, e que este meu serviço em Jerusalém seja bem aceito pelos santos,

versos.grego: ἵνα ἐν χαρᾷ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ συναναπαύσωμαι ὑμῖν.

controles.web: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
controles.kjv: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
controles.livre: a fim de que eu possa chegar até vós com alegria, pela vontade de Deus, e que eu possa descansar convosco.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν· ἀμήν.

controles.web: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
controles.kjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
controles.livre: E o Deus da paz esteja com todos vós. Amém!
